title: Wildland Fire Technology
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement in WILDLAND FIRE TECHNOLOGY with emphasis on employment preparation
outcomes: Students will recall the ten Standard Firefighting Orders.
Students will identify wildland fire tools, including shovel, Pulaski, and McLeod.
Students will describe the steps to safely deploy a fire shelter.
Students will explain the proper use of the following tools and equipment: back pump, fuses, and backfire torch.
Students will describe the functions within the Incident Command System.
Students will assess impacts of fuel, weather, and topography on wildland fire behavior.
Students will describe weather, and topography and how it affects wildland fire behavior.

notes: The page also prints a noncredit Certificate of Completion in Wildland Fire Technology (FIRE 100, FIRE 110, 0 units) with its own outcomes; it was not recorded here.
